baseline_note: Positions come from THUD reference depth and the recorded reference camera poses (controlled experimental baseline). Results do not measure an RGB-only depth model or an estimated camera pose.
settings_provenance: All values below were fixed from physical reasoning before any motion evaluation was run, and were not changed after seeing evaluation results. The Step 4 supplement statistics (development capture, timing and step sizes) had been seen. No value was adjusted on Capture_2.

ground_plane.rule: predicted-floor world heights (Step 4 frames.jsonl): within-frame IQR and across-frame range must both be below max_floor_height_spread_m

quality.rule: reliable = position_valid AND depth IQR of the selected pixels <= the limit for its pixel_source (class_mask 0.5 m, fallback 0.25 m). A larger IQR means at least a quarter of the pixels lie well apart from another quarter (two surfaces, e.g. an occluder in front): flagged unreliable, never resolved by picking the nearest depth cluster. No reference data is used.
quality.why: 0.5 m is about the visible depth extent of one person or chair; the fallback (box minus wall/floor/ceiling) is more exposed to other objects, so its limit is stricter.

motion.estimator: least-squares line fit of ground-plane x(t) and z(t) over the trailing window of reliable observations in the current segment; slope = velocity, line value at the current time = filtered position
motion.reset_rules: a new segment starts when the gap since the previous reliable observation exceeds max_gap_s, when the ground-plane jump exceeds jump_base_m + max_plausible_speed_mps * dt, or when the detector class changes

labels.rule: World speed hysteresis: moving at >= enter, stationary at <= exit, otherwise the previous state. A moving object is approaching / moving_away when its OWN world velocity component toward / away from camera_proxy is at least radial_min_speed_mps, otherwise moving_lateral. A new label is emitted only after it has persisted for persistence_s.

motion_trust.rule: motion_trusted = true only for an estimated motion of a detector class in dynamic_classes. Other classes keep their motion values with motion_trusted = false.
motion_trust.use: Step 9 decision rules use only trusted motion. Static obstacles enter decisions through the passage-width map, not through motion labels.
motion_trust.why: Design decision, not tuning. Furniture motion error is systematic drift: mask coverage changes and a viewpoint-dependent visible-surface point (46% false motion even on the reference visible point). A longer window averages noise but cannot remove drift that follows the camera's path.

route.assumption: constant ground-plane velocity from the current filtered position over the horizon; the corridor is static
